fee_notes: Standard Initial Franchise Fee is $45,000 due at signing. During 2025, actual fees ranged from $0 to $45,000 due to waivers and discounts. Available programs: Franchise Option Program (refund fee for 4% higher royalty for 10 years), Military/First Responder Program (20% reduction), Multi-Unit Program (25% reduction for 2nd+ units), Hard to Serve/Underserved Markets (up to 10% discount), Conversion Franchise Program (waives fee for qualified applicants with 6+ months history and $25,000+ sales).
raw_excerpt: You will pay us an initial franchise fee of $45,000 (the "Initial Franchise Fee"). The Initial Franchise Fee is due in full at the time you sign the Franchise Agreement. During 2025 our franchise offering included waivers, discounts and refunds such that our Initial Franchise Fees ranged from $0 to $45,000.
